newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian c.bank to sell Savings Bank stake - report.
newsitem.headline: Estonian c.bank to sell Savings Bank stake - report.

text.p: The Estonian central bank is to sell its remaining shares in second largest bank Savings Bank, newspaper Aripaev on Thursday quoted bank officials as saying.

The central bank was not immediately available to comment on the report, which quoted a central bank spokeswoman as saying it would sell its 17 percent stake in Savings Bank to avoid a conflict of interest.
The deputy chairman of Savings Bank, Priit Haller, told Aripaev that he was not concerned over the idea of the central bank selling its stake.
"Our bank has been operating successfully and continues to do so," Haller was quoted as saying.
